intentEvidence: This plugin brings their work into Obsidian tabs and adds vault saving, command palette actions, and Markdown conversion.
motivation: I built Hangle Editor after seeing rhwp and HOP because I wanted to edit Korean Hangul documents alongside the notes in my personal knowledge vault.
problem: Users need a way to edit Korean Hangul documents (HWPX/HWP) directly within their personal knowledge vault without installing a full office suite.

relations.evidence: Edward Kim’s rhwp reads, lays out, and writes HWP and HWPX documents.

summary: A lightweight editor that integrates HWPX and HWP document editing capabilities into Obsidian using rhwp and HOP.
